instruction:
Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-15_input.step. To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). For this workflow, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-15_input.step`.

In the 200 x 44 x 12 mm rail plate, cut a shallow top groove spanning X=20..180, Y=14..30, and Z=8..12. Cut ten vertical through holes of diameter 5 mm along Y=22 at X=22, 39.5, 57, 74.5, 92, 109.5, 127, 144.5, 162, and 179.5. Cut two through obround cross slots along Y: one centered at (62,22), length 30 mm and width 6 mm, and another centered at (142,22), length 34 mm and width 8 mm. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-15_output.step.
